Choose an experiment for the finite causal prediction task. The public task gives a common observational joint, candidate causal orders, a prior over candidate worlds, three allowed actions, and a held-out interventional query. You may call evaluate_action for an action ID to receive its exact public-input prior-averaged one-step Bayes risk in nats. Lower risk is better. You can make at most three evaluation calls, including repeated calls. You may submit a final action before using all calls. A final answer must be one of A, B, C, or STOP; STOP keeps the initial risk.

When operation is final, action_id may also be STOP. The tool transcript lists only calls already made. You have 3 evaluation calls remaining. If this is zero, operation must be final. Return no prose.
